steps.what: List the stored seminar date and topic
Conduct financial planning seminars on retirement topics
Conduct estate workshops and severance package evaluation

outputs: filed copy of signed seminar note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists the stored seminar date and topic. The advisor conducts the seminars and workshops on retirement planning, estate planning, and the evaluation of severance packages. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not deliver the session and it does not score an attendee.
tasks.previous_blocker: The session ran from memory of the date and the topic.
tasks.enabler_now: Seminar date and topic are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Conducting the session stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides how to treat a question from the room.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week in the room, not on the date list.

reach.task: Hear the session from the advisor, against the signed note

evidence.claim: The advisor conducts the seminar. A stored date does not deliver it.

assumptions: Seminar date and topic are stored on the calendar record. The calendar record produces them. A blank topic is not a seminar. The advisor conducts the session.
Native configuration of the calendar record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor conducting financial planning seminars on retirement topics.

incremental.description: Refresh seminar date and topic when the calendar layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many seminar topics are blank. The high end assumes seminar date and topic are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed plan note can be filed the same day, and the advisor still decides the strategy.
